items.english: First, look at soil structure. In the field, feel how a moist piece breaks apart.
items.draft: Okokuqala, jonga isakhiwo somhlaba. Entsimini, vakalisa indlela esiqhekeka ngayo isiqwenga esifumileyo.
items.backtranslation: First, look at the soil structure. In the field, observe how a moist lump breaks.
items.problem: 'vakalisa' means make audible/show, not feel; the hands-on feel test was lost.
items.corrected: Okokuqala, jonga isakhiwo somhlaba. Entsimini, bamba isiqwenga esifumileyo uzive ngesandla indlela esiqhekeka ngayo.

items.english: A hot centre does not prove that every part of a heap has been treated. Time, temperature and management all matter.
items.draft: Iqondo eliphakathi elishushu aliqinisekisi ukuba yonke inxalenye yenqwaba iphathiwe. Ixesha, ubushushu nolawulo zonke ziyabalulekile.
items.backtranslation: A medium warm degree does not confirm that every part of the heap has been treated. Time, heat and management are all important.
items.problem: Safety: 'iqondo eliphakathi elishushu' reads as 'medium warm temperature', not 'a hot centre'; meaning of the heat-is-not-proof warning blurred.
items.corrected: Ukuba umbindi wenqwaba ushushu akuqinisekisi ukuba yonke inxalenye yenqwaba iphathiwe. Ixesha, ubushushu nolawulo zonke ziyabalulekile.

items.english: Keep meat, dairy, diseased plants, pet waste and contaminated materials out of this simple household system.
items.draft: Musa ukufaka inyama, ubisi neemveliso zobisi, izityalo ezigulayo, inkunkuma yezilwanyana zasekhaya nezinto ezingcolisiweyo kule nkqubo ilula yasekhaya.
items.backtranslation: Do not put in meat, milk and dairy products, diseased plants, pet/domestic animal waste and contaminated things in this simple home process.
items.problem: Safety/term: 'pet waste' rendered as waste of domestic animals generally, which wrongly bars livestock manure (normal compost input) and is wider than the source.
items.corrected: Musa ukufaka inyama, ubisi neemveliso zobisi, izityalo ezigulayo, inkunkuma yeenja neekati nezinto ezingcolisiweyo kule nkqubo ilula yasekhaya.
